handbookNote: Code of Alabama 1975, Title 36, Chapter 20 (Notaries Public), current general Notary Public Act effective 9/1/2023 (Ala. Code Sec. 36-20-70 training mandate, Sec. 36-20-75 misconduct/discipline) -- Alabama is uniquely commissioned at the COUNTY level by the Probate Judge (not a Secretary of State), with a mandatory Alabama Probate Judges Association / Alabama Law Institute training course embedded in the commissioning process itself rather than a separate standalone exam. Priced at $0.99 (2026-08-16 directive): unlike this project's other Notary tracks, AL has no confirmed graded assessment of any kind, so this is education-only practice content, not exam prep -- priced accordingly, well below the $9.99 exam-state tier.
